None of the required changes to `src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, `CHANGELOG.md`, or `example/full-config.ts` were made.
